## OpenRSVP v1.10.1

This patch release makes the public homepage align with the organizer signup policy and tightens the magic-link confirmation text.

### Highlights

- The homepage now reads the live `allowSignups` value from `/api/v1/config`, so super-admin changes to public organizer signup policy take effect without restarting OpenRSVP.
- When public organizer signups are disabled, the homepage no longer offers new visitors a public organizer signup form. Existing organizers can still request a sign-in link.
- Magic-link requests now use an account-enumeration-safe confirmation notice instead of confirming whether a specific email address received a link.
- Added `git-usage.md` to document the maintainer Git, release-candidate, and stable release workflow.

### Container tags

The release publishes `1.10.1`, `1.10`, `1`, `latest`, and a commit-specific `sha-*` tag to `ghcr.io/ianwardell/openrsvp`.
